title: Innokin Jem Pen Coils
description: These quality Kanthal coils from Innokin are designed to enhance your vape experience when used with the Jem Pen kit, offering unbelievable flavour, smooth delivery and exceptional vapour production. With two compatible options each with a different resistance range, you can choose the right coil for your particular needs, or swap between the two for a varied vape. The coil option rated at 1.6ohm is ideal for producing thick, luscious vapour which really hits the spot, while the 2ohm ceramic coil option uses slightly less power for a vape which is similar to the sensation of smoking a classic tobacco cigarette. These work well with Nicotine Salts and even High PG E-Liquids. Each coil is designed to facilitate mouth-to-lung vaping, making these coils and indeed the Jem Pen kit itself a great option for anyone wanting to make the switch from smoking to vaping. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
